name: Kaapi Club
story: Kaapi Club started as a tee drop for the regulars of a Malleshwaram filter-coffee counter. Every piece is cut for long Bengaluru days that start with decoction and end on a rooftop.

name: Rao & Sons
story: Three generations of the Rao family have cut cloth on the same Chickpet street since 1962. Their blazers keep the old-school canvas structure but drop the stiffness for modern stages.

name: Indigo Loom
tagline: Denim and trousers, wide-leg to slim
story: Indigo Loom works with small mills to weave denim and trouser cloth that softens with every wear. From roomy wide-legs to sharp slims, every pair is hemmed to Indian heights.

name: Kerb
tagline: Sneakers and loafers for city miles
story: Kerb makes clean sneakers and soft loafers built to survive Bengaluru pavements. Cushioned soles, honest leather and nothing you have to break in.

name: Cap Theory
story: Cap Theory believes the right hat finishes a look and starts a conversation. Small-batch caps, beanies and bucket hats, stitched in Tiruppur.

name: Second Hand
story: Second Hand designs everyday watches inspired by the dials our grandparents wore. Analog and retro digital pieces that keep time and good taste.

name: Lens Lane
story: Lens Lane designs frames and chains that sit somewhere between studio and street. Lightweight acetate, honest metal and shapes that suit Indian faces.
